You are locked in Lab 4. Use **DrugBank**, **UniProt** and the **PDB** to get out.

## Rules

- Teams of 4. **One laptop** runs the game; the others search.
- **Log in to DrugBank** before you start.
- **70 minutes**, **10 rooms**. Each room opens with one code.
- Each room has **2 hints**. Every hint adds **5 minutes**.
- **No AI chatbots.** Databases only.
- Every room gives you **one letter**. Together they make the **exit word**.
- Write the exit word on your **group sheet** and bring it to the teacher.

## Winning

- Ranking: **time** (hints included), then **fewest wrong codes**.
- The **first 4 teams** win: 1.00 point, 0.75, 0.50, and 0.25, respectively. Every other team gets a **bonus mission**.
